machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest, archlinux:base-devel container, no GPU, cage on the wlroots headless backend with the pixman renderer

startup_seconds.note: Process start to the first buffer on the toplevel's surface, median of three launches. The three were 1.127, 0.690 and 0.668 s, the first paying for a cold page cache. The ceiling is about four times the median, which is what the startup probes in docs/development.md use, because a shared runner's speed is not its own.

memory_mebibytes.note: Proportional set size of the whole process tree, one Space, one page. The ceiling is twice the measurement, as the frozen-tab probe's is.

space_mebibytes.note: What each Space after the first adds, each holding the same page, averaged over four Spaces. The run was 482.7, 659.8, 682.0 and 705.2 MiB: the second Space costs the engine a set of processes the rest then share, so the average is above the 23 MiB each later Space added. The ceiling is twice the average.

frozen_growth_mebibytes.note: What an away Space's page goes on taking once frozen, over ten seconds, against ADR 0033. Tighter than the others on purpose: the same page grew 30.1 MiB in the six seconds it was on show, so a page still running would add about fifty here, and a reading's own noise is a megabyte or two.

pageload_fresh_hosts_milliseconds.note: What Content blocking adds to a page of 40 images from 40 hosts it has never seen, the median with blocking on minus the median with the site switched off, ten loads each: 136.6 ms against 130.5 ms. Measured on 2026-09-26 against Arch's qt6-webengine, where CNAME uncloaking is compiled out, so this holds the rule check, the Refusal tally and the refused-request list but not uncloaking's lookups; #394 re-records it on Omaweb's engine. Secure DNS off. The hosts resolve through dnsmasq on the container's resolver, with CNAME chains, not host-resolver rules. Procedural cosmetic filtering is measured separately under #402. The ceiling is four times the difference. Three loads the engine cut short were repeated and not counted.

pageload_known_hosts_milliseconds.note: The same for 40 images from 4 hosts resolved on the warm-up loads: 147.6 ms against 145.0 ms. Measured on 2026-09-26 against Arch's qt6-webengine, where CNAME uncloaking is compiled out, so this holds the rule check, the Refusal tally and the refused-request list but not uncloaking's lookups; #394 re-records it on Omaweb's engine. Secure DNS off. The hosts resolve through dnsmasq on the container's resolver, with CNAME chains, not host-resolver rules. Procedural cosmetic filtering is measured separately under #402. Four times the difference is 10.4 ms, under the 20 ms floor, because a shared runner's noise is bigger than a difference this small.
